extracted.name: Corn Tomato Salad
extracted.description: This fresh corn and tomato salad, complete with red onion, bell pepper, and a garlicky balsamic vinaigrette, is a great option for any summer meal.
ingredient_lines: 1 red bell pepper, seeded and diced
instruction_lines: Place corn into a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then cook until kernels are tender but crisp, about 5 minutes. Drain and cool for about 5 minutes.

Use a knife to scrape corn kernels from the cobs into a large bowl. Add bell pepper, onion, tomato, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and garlic. Toss to combine and season with pepper. Chill for 15 minutes before serving.
